name: 46237 · Indianapolis, IN
findings: ZIP 46237 (Indianapolis) has 110 nonprofit organizations. 47 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 41 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 46237 (Indianapolis) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
